_comment: Maintained by scripts/rate_check (morning rate-checker). Per-box rates (Box Engine v2): ceil(Shippo least-cost ground [UPS Ground vs USPS Ground Advantage, transit-guarded at the box's SHIP MODE] at the box's representative billable weight + per-box packaging + 2.00 buffer). Bareroot small/large quote at DORMANT (7-day ceiling); potted/peat-and-bagged p24x10x4/p24x10x6 quote at LEAFED (3-day ceiling), the pricier mode they actually ship, so the static rate never undercharges the label the checkout buys in any season (GOL-2238 P1 fix, 2026-09-14). GOL-2238: zone_7 = {TN}. TN bareroot is FLAT $20/$24 across the state (one USPS zone from 26651); the earlier 29/32 was a stale UPS-Ground-only figure, an overcharge now corrected. TN potted 39/46 is the true worst-corner cost (Chattanooga) — potted to TN is pricey everywhere, even the WV-bordering NE tip, because peat's 3-day ceiling forces UPS Ground; this is NOT a Memphis worst-corner artifact. zone_6 = {AR,MO,IA}: bareroot 23/28, potted 41/52 (Little Rock/Jefferson City/Des Moines all co-maximal). NOTE: zones 1-6 potted rows predate the SHIP_MODE fix and still carry dormant-mode (USPS-GA) values that UNDERCHARGE their leafed label; the next scheduled rate-check run re-derives them at leafed under the corrected methodology (pricing delta pending CEO ratification, GOL-2238). Design: vault wiki/Software/Grove Shipping.
